description: Prohibits non-dog animals from entering off-leash areas.
Forbids false information on animal license applications.

chips.text: Pet owners will not face new limits on the number of animals per household.
Amendments respond to public concerns and animal services working group input.

description: Saskatoon will draft a bylaw to prohibit feeding wildlife.
City will enhance coyote management with a wildlife specialist.
An awareness campaign on coyotes and feeding will launch.

chips.text: Councillor Kelleher advocated for aggressive fines for residents caught feeding dangerous animals.
Residents in parks like W.J. Harvey North are afraid to walk due to coyote encounters.
Specific criteria for hazing, trapping, or euthanizing coyotes were not yet defined.
Residents have long warned that high rabbit populations attract foxes and coyotes to the city.
Removing too many coyotes risks population growth as nature fills the void.
Administration will present a full coyote management and response plan for 2026-27 budget.

description: Province cancelled Code Accelerator Fund, halting energy code acceleration.
Residential energy code reverts from Tier 2 to Tier 1, reducing efficiency.
Council directed exploring options to maintain current Tier 2 standards.

chips.text: Councillor Jeffries argued maintaining Tier 2 saves homeowners money long-term.
New homeowners will face higher long-term utility costs.
Home Builders Association views reverting to Tier 1 as unnecessary.
Reverting to Tier 1 impacts the city's 2036 net-zero readiness target.

description: Council informed about Public Art Advisory Committee's 2024 work.
Development Appeals Board's 2024 annual report made public.
Council informed about 2024 Heritage Advisory Committee activities.
Municipal Heritage Advisory Committee's 2025 Work Plan forwarded to Council.
